storylines.text: Esmerlyn Valdez is running hot right now, hitting well above his 0.288 season average over his last games with at least one home run in that stretch. He faces CHC sends out Shota Imanaga today, in a pitcher-friendly park, a pitcher who's allowed a 0.232 average against this season. This pitcher has also been genuinely tougher to hit hard once he gets to two strikes this season, not just generically good.
